usage: The word 雀 (zoek3) is a noun referring to a small bird, commonly known as a sparrow in English.
雀 can be used to talk about birds generally, but it often specifically means sparrows in everyday conversations.
To make 雀 plural, no change is needed; context will indicate more than one bird.
雀 can be combined with other words to specify different types of birds, such as 麻雀 (maa4 zoek3) meaning sparrow.
雀 is often used in simple sentences to describe seeing, hearing, or talking about birds.
